with ins as ( insert into goodfish_item (account_id, goodfish_account_id, goodfish_item_id, title, description, price, stock_status, image_url, sync_time, del_flag) values
(#{it.accountId}, #{it.goodfishAccountId}, #{it.goodfishItemId}, #{it.title}, #{it.description}, #{it.price}, #{it.stockStatus}, #{it.imageUrl}, #{it.syncTime}, '0')
on conflict (goodfish_account_id, goodfish_item_id) do update set title = excluded.title, description = excluded.description, price = excluded.price, stock_status = excluded.stock_status, image_url = excluded.image_url, sync_time = excluded.sync_time, del_flag = '0', update_time = now() returning (xmax = 0) as inserted ) select count(*) filter (where inserted) as "insertedCount", count(*) filter (where not inserted) as "updatedCount" from ins

select i.*, p.system_prompt, p.price_prompt, p.tech_prompt, p.default_prompt, p.max_reply_length from goodfish_item i left join goodfish_item_prompt p on p.item_id = i.id where i.id = #{id} and i.del_flag = '0'

select i.goodfish_item_id, i.title, i.description, i.price, i.stock_status, i.image_url, p.system_prompt, p.price_prompt, p.tech_prompt, p.default_prompt, p.max_reply_length from goodfish_item i left join goodfish_item_prompt p on p.item_id = i.id where i.goodfish_account_id = #{goodfishAccountId} and i.goodfish_item_id = #{goodfishItemId} and i.del_flag = '0'
